spans.s:
(औ) तपौ r. 1st cl. (तपति-ते) r. 4th cl. (तप्यति-ते) and r. 10th cl. [] (तापयति-ते)
1 To heat or be hot, to burn; (hence figuratively,) to suffer mental or bodily pain.
2 To have pre-eminent or superhuman power:
the deponent form only is used when the root with the prefix उत् or वि occurs intransitively, or governs as its object part of the body of the agent, as पाणिं वितपते warms the hand, (उत्तपते वितपते) shines, burns, &c. The root takes the passive form also, when implying religious meditation, as तप्यते तपस्तापसः the devotee revolves religious thoughts.
With अनु prefixed,
(अनुतपते)
To repent, to regret.
With परि or सम्
(परितपति सन्तपति,)
1 To bear or inflict pain, anguish, heat, distress, &c.
2 To be sorrowful, to repent.

m. (-पः)
1 The hot season, summer.
2 Heat, warmth.
3 The sun.
E.
तप to heat, affix अच्.

m. (-पः)
1 Heat, burning, (moral or physical.)
2 Pain, sorrow, distress.
E.
तप to burn or inflame, affix घञ्
f. (-पी)
A name of the Tapti or Surat river.
2 A name of the Yamunā or Jumna river.
E.
तप the sun, affix of descent इण्.

m. (-रः)
The mango fish: see तपस्विन्.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Emaciated by austerities.
E.
तपस्, and कृश lean.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Patient of austerities.
E.
तपस् austere devotion, क्लश fatigue, and सह bearing.

f. (-ली)
A name of Benāres.
E.
तपस् religious austerities, and स्थल soil, place, fem. affix ङीष्.

mfn. (-पन्-पन्ती-पत्)
1 Heating or warming.
2 Performing penance.
E.
तप to heat, शतृ aff.

f. (-ती)
1 A name of CHĀYĀ, wife of the sun.
2 Also of the daughter of the sun, or the personified Taptī river, married to SAṂVARAṆA of the Kuru family.
E.
तप heat or the sun, and अत who accompanies, fem. affix ङीष्.

m. (-तः)
1 The sun.
2 A division of hell.
3 Heat, burning.
4 Mental distress, pining, grieving.
5 The hot season.
6 The marking nut plant.
f. (-नी)
The Godāvarī river.
E.
तप to inflame, affixes ल्युट् and ङीष्.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
What heats or inflames.
m. (-नः)
1 The sun.
2 One of KĀMA'S arrows, the inflamer.
3 Sun-shine.
4 Heating, inflaming.
E.
तप to heat, in the causal form, and ल्युट् aff.

m. (-रः)
A ray, a sun-beam.
E.
तपन, and कर a ray.

m. (-यः)
KARṆA, &c.
f. (-या)
1 The Yamunā river.
2 The Tapti.
E.
तपन, the sun, and तनय child.

m. (-णिः)
The sun-stone.
E.
तपन, and मणि a gem.

m. (-शुः)
A ray of the sun, a sun-beam.
E.
तपन, and अंशु ray.

f. (-जा)
1 The Godāvarī river.
2 The Yamunā or Jumna river.
E.
तपन the sun, and आत्मजा a daughter.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be heated.
2 To be suffered or practised as penance.
n. (-यं)
Gold.
E.
तप to heat, &c. अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Golden, made of gold.
E.
तपनीय, and अण् aff.

n. (-कं)
Gold.
E.
तपनीय, and कन् added.

n. (-ष्टं)
Copper.
E.
तपन, and इष्ट liked.

m. (-पाः)
1 The name of a month, Māgha, (January-February.)
2 The cold or dewy season.
3 The hot season.
n. (-पः)
1 Religious austerity, penance, mortification, the practice of mental or personal self-denial, or the infliction of bodily tortures.
2 A world, the region above the Janaloka, inhabited by saints or devotees after death.
3 Virtue, moral merit.
4 Duty, the special observance of certain things: thus the Tapas of a Brahman is sacred learning; of a Kṣatriya, the protection of subjects; of a Vaiśya, almsgiving to Brahmans; of a Śūdra, the service of the same tribe; and of a Ṛṣi or saint, feeding upon herbs and roots.
E.
तप to heat or inflame, affix असुन.

m. (-सः)
1 The moon.
2 A bird.
E.
तप to heat, असच् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-सः-सी-सं)
Performing penance, a practiser of devout austerities, a devotee, an ascetic.
m. (-सः)
A kind of crane, (Ardea nivea).
n. (-सं)
The leaf of the Laurus cassia.
E.
तपस penance, affix अण्.

m. (-क्षः)
A name of INDRA.
E.
तपम् austerity, and तक्ष who pares or makes thin; emaciating himself by his devotions.

m. (-स्यः)
1 The month Phālguna, (February-March.) A name of ARJUNA.
f. (-स्या)
1 Devout austerity, religious penance.
n. (-स्यं)
The flower of the Kunda, (Jasminum pubescens.)
E.
तपस् the cold season, यत् aff.

mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि)
1 Devout, practising austerities.
2 Poor, wretched, pitiable.
m. (-स्वी)
1 An ascetic, a religious man engaged in the practice of rigorous and devout penance.
2 A name of

NĀRADA.
3

A mendicant, a pauper.
4 The mango fish (Polynemus risua.)
f. (-स्विनी)
1 A female devotee, a woman leading a religious life.
2 Spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansi.)
3 Another plant: see कटुरोहिणी.
E.
तपस् religious austerity, the hot season, &c. विनि aff.

m. (-धिः)
The practice of penance.
E.
तपस्, and समाधि obligation.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Practising austerities.
E.
तप, and आत्मक self.

m. (-यः)
The rainy season.
E.
तप the warm season, and अत्यय destroying; following the hot weather.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Heated, burnt.
E.
तप to heat, affix क्त, with इट् inserted.

Inflamed.
2

Distressed, pained.
E.
तप to inflame, affix क्त.

Fire.
2

The sun.
E.
तप to heat, Uṇādi affix उसि.

m. (-नः)
A devotee, an ascetic, one who performs religious penance.
f. (-ना)
A plant: see मुण्डीरी.
E.
तपस् religious austerity, and धन wealth.

m. (-वः)
The influence of religious penance.
E.
तपस, and अनुभाव authority.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Performing penance, practising austerities.
E.
तपस्, and निष्ठ engaged in.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Devout, practising austerities.
E.
तपस्, and मयट् aff.

mfn. (-र्त्तिः)
An ascetic.
E.
तपस्, and मूर्त्ति form.

m. (-शिः)
An ascetic.
E.
तपस्, and राशि a heap.

m. (-टः)
A country, part of central India or holy land.
E.
तपस् religious austerity, and वट what surrounds.

n. (-नं)
A sacred grove, a place frequented by ascetics.
E.
तपस्, and वन a wood.

mfn. (-प्रः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Heated, inflamed, burnt.
2 Scorched by pain or sorrow, distressed, afflicted.
3 Inflamed with anger, incensed.
4 Undergone or performed^1 as penance.
5 Fused, melted.
6 Burnished.
E.
तप to heat, क्त aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-म्भः)
A hell.
E.
तप्त, and कुम्भ a jar.

n. (-च्छ्रं)
A sort of penance, drinking hot water, milk, and ghee for three days each, and inhaling hot air for three days.
E.
तप्त heated, कृच्छ्र penance.

m. (-पाः)
An ascetic.
E.
तप्त, and तपस् penance.

n. (-ण्डं)
A hell.
E.
तप्त, पाषाण a stone, and कुण्ड a well.

m. (-कः)
A hell.
E.
तप्त, and वालुका sand.

n. (-कं)
Silver.
E.
तप्त, and रूपक silver.

ind.
1 Having heated.
2 Having performed penance.
E.
तप, and क्त्वा aff.

mfn. (-प्स्यन्-प्स्यन्ती-प्स्यत्)
Practising or intending to practise austerities.
E.
तप to perform penance, शतृ affix, future part.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Burning, inflaming, heating.
m. (-कः)
Fever, morbid heat.
E.
तप to burn, ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-त्यः)
ARJUNA.
E.
तपती, and यञ् affix of descent.

m. (-कः)
A contemptible devotee, one not long engaged in austerities.
E.
तापस, and कन् depreciative aff.

m. (-रुः)
A tree, commonly Ingua or Jiyaputa, (Nagelia putranjiva.)
E.
तापस an ascetic, and तरु a tree; also similar compounds, as तापसद्रुम, तापसवृक्ष, &c.

m. (-यः)
A tree, (Chironjia sapida): see पियाल.
f. (-या)
A grape.
E.
तापस an ascetic, प्रिय beloved by.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Cooling, removing heat.
2 Consoling, alleviating distress.
f. (-री)
A dish, a sort of soup, of pulse and grain, first fried with ghee and turmeric, and afterwards boiled with salt and sugar.
E.
ताप, and हर what removes.

m. (-च्छः)
A tree bearing dark blossoms, the Tamāla: see the next.

m. (-ञ्छः)
The Tamāla tree, (Xanthocymus pictorius.)
E.
तापिन् a person heated, and छद what covers or shelters, ड affix, deriv. irr.; also the final being dropped तापिच्छ, and with जि to conquer or remove तातिञ्ज.

m. (-ञ्जः)
The Tamāla tree.
n. (-ञ्जं)
Sulphuret of iron: see the preceding.

mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि)
Oppressed by heat, morbid, moral or physical; any thing heated or glowing.
m. (-पी)
One of the deified saints of the Bauddhas.
E.
तप to heat, affix णिनि.

mn. (-प्यः-प्यं)
A mineral substance, sulphuret of iron.
E.
तापी the river, and यत् affix; said to be procured from the Tāpi river; also with कन् added ताप्यकं.
